description.name: Entry
description.text:
Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Ice with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode], and Crystal Force Mode: Umaro to the user
Crystal Force Mode: Umaro: Ice Ability Boost, Dualcast Ice, Zero Hone Cost to Ice Abilities & 25% DEF/RES Pierce
Crystal Force I/II: Single-target Ice/NE physical attack (10.00) capped at 199999, Instant Cast, grants [Damage Cap +20000 1], [Ice Ability +50% Boost 1], [Dualcast Ice 1], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 1], and [200% ATB 1] to the user

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions

description.name: DEF and RES 50% Piercing 1
description.text: Ignores 50% of the target's DEF and RES

description.name: 200% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x2.00
